ayahs.arabic: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.translit: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two]

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةࣰ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرࣱ مُّسۡتَمِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.translit: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرࣲ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.translit: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence

ayahs.arabic: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةࣱۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.translit: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them]

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَيۡءࣲ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.translit: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding

ayahs.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادࣱ مُّنتَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading

ayahs.arabic: مُّهۡطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِۖ يَقُولُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day

ayahs.arabic: ۞كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ فَكَذَّبُواْ عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُواْ مَجۡنُونࣱ وَٱزۡدُجِرَ
ayahs.translit: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled

ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبࣱ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
ayahs.translit: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help

ayahs.arabic: فَفَتَحۡنَآ أَبۡوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءࣲ مُّنۡهَمِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

ayahs.arabic: وَفَجَّرۡنَا ٱلۡأَرۡضَ عُيُونࣰ ا فَٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمۡرࣲ قَدۡ قُدِرَ
ayahs.translit: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined

ayahs.arabic: وَحَمَلۡنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلۡوَٰحࣲ وَدُسُرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails

ayahs.arabic: تَجۡرِي بِأَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.translit: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادࣱ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحࣰ ا صَرۡصَرࣰ ا فِي يَوۡمِ نَحۡسࣲ مُّسۡتَمِرࣲّ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Thamud denied the warning

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣰ ا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدࣰ ا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.translit: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness

ayahs.arabic: أَءُلۡقِيَ ٱلذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar

ayahs.arabic: سَيَعۡلَمُونَ غَدࣰ ا مَّنِ ٱلۡكَذَّابُ ٱلۡأَشِرُ
ayahs.translit: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا مُرۡسِلُواْ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةࣰ لَّهُمۡ فَٱرۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَٱصۡطَبِرۡ
ayahs.translit: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient

ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةُۢ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ كُلُّ شِرۡبࣲ مُّحۡتَضَرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn]

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَوۡاْ صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.translit: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her]

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
ayahs.translit: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوطِۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The people of Lot denied the warning

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲۖ نَّجَّيۡنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

ayahs.arabic: نِّعۡمَةࣰ مِّنۡ عِندِنَاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.translit: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَنذَرَهُم بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡاْ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيۡفِهِۦ فَطَمَسۡنَآ أَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابࣱ مُّسۡتَقِرࣱّ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.translit: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So taste My punishment and warning

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ أَخۡذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
ayahs.translit: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability

ayahs.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡ أُوْلَٰٓئِكُمۡ أَمۡ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translit: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيعࣱ مُّنتَصِرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]

ayahs.arabic: سَيُهۡزَمُ ٱلۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.translit: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat]

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدۡهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.translit: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُونَ فِي ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمۡ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَٰهُ بِقَدَرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, all things We created with predestination

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَمۡرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمۡحِۭ بِٱلۡبَصَرِ
ayahs.translit: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَآ أَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءࣲ فَعَلُوهُ فِي ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.translit: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And everything they did is in written records

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرࣲ وَكَبِيرࣲ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
ayahs.translit: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَنَهَرࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers

ayahs.arabic: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
ayahs.translit: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability
